The '''''Gray Gull''''' is a river ship captain by [[Huan Mallia]].

==Activities==
The ''Gray Gull'' takes [[Matrim Cauthon]] and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] from the docks at [[Tar Valon]] to [[Aringill]] in [[Andor]].{{ref/book|3|32}}{{ref/book|3|40}}. While aboard, Mat and Thom are attacked by Darkfriends in the night.

==Crew members==
*Huan Mallia - captain
*[[Sanor]]
*[[Vasa]]
